name: vintage-sunburst-rays
title: Vintage Sunburst Rays
description: Retro radial sunburst flare with alternating light and dark beams radiating upward from bottom.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Muted Earth

## Rules

- Passive Sunburst Flare: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
